name: Träumerei
source:
Spring is in full bloom.
For Saki Kashiwagi, who has just entered university, campus life is full of excitement.
Joining a club with only men, her first part-time job, which she experiences without telling her parents. Her brand new diary is filled with the small incidents that happen each day.

Then one day, her precocious best friend, Kyoko Takano, teaches Saki about "the reality of men".

Secrets in a locked room that should never be seen.

Even after witnessing everything, Saki still couldn't believe it.
And even in Saki's body, which fears sex, an uninhibited urge begins to stir.
In bed late at night, her cheeks, which still retain a touch of innocence, turn red with embarrassment.

"This is wrong, doing something so lewd..."

The next day, Saki's heart trembles violently at the temptation of Ryo Kishimoto, a senior in her club.

Is it "love" or is it "desire"? Innocent Saki couldn't even tell the difference.
On the way from "girl" to "woman", many obstacles stand in Saki's way.

As the poignant melody of "Träumerei" plays, will Saki be able to overcome her challenges and find her "true self"?

[Translated from the official website]
translation:
春天正是百花盛开的时候。
对于刚刚进入大学的柏木沙希来说，校园生活充满了精彩。
加入一个只有男性的俱乐部，这是她的第一份兼职工作，她在没有告诉父母的情况下经历了这件事。她全新的日记充满了每天发生的小事件。

有一天，她早熟的好朋友高野恭子向咲讲授“男人的现实”。

上锁的房间里藏着永远不应该被人看见的秘密。

即使亲眼目睹了这一切，咲希仍然不敢相信。
即使在咲希对性充满恐惧的身体里，也开始涌动着一种不受抑制的冲动。
深夜的床上，她还保留着一抹纯真的脸颊，羞得通红。

“这是不对的，做出如此下流的事……”

第二天，在社团前辈岸本亮的诱惑下，咲的心脏剧烈颤抖。

是“爱”还是“欲”？无辜的咲甚至无法分辨出其中的区别。
在从“女孩”到“女人”的路上，咲希遇到了重重障碍。

随着《Träumerei》凄美旋律的响起，咲能否克服挑战，找到“真实的自己”呢？
